title: studio → pipelines: run one failed row again
description: Studio's outbox relay publishes it on subject `cmd.pipeline.retry` (stream CMD) in the transaction that changes the batch; Nats-Msg-Id `<batch_id>:<n>`, n = the batch's command counter (submit = 1, +1 per later command). pipelines_service consumes it (durable `pipelines`, filter `cmd.pipeline.>`, one message at a time, in order). Sent on POST /v1/studio/batches/{id}/rows/{n}/retry; studio has set the row `queued` with this attempt. Pipelines runs the row's thread again from its start with `attempt` in its idempotency keys (so a new run).
